entities.title: Online rooms belong to the games hub
entities.summary: The Durable Object that held online rooms moved to the games hub; Hivestorm only connects to it.
entities.context: Rally, Shatterbelt and Hivestorm all play online, and players meet in one multiplayer lobby.
entities.decision: The relay is a Durable Object per match in the games hub, at /games/multiplayer/match/{ID}. Hivestorm's Worker deletes its old Room class, and both migration entries are kept.
entities.rationale: One lobby and one relay for every game; Cloudflare applies migrations in order, so removing the first entry would break the deploy.

entities.title: Should public/.dev be published with the game?
entities.summary: The build copies public/ into dist/ whole, so public/.dev/folder.json is uploaded with the static assets and served under the game's address.
entities.context: build.mjs copies public/ with cpSync("public", site, { recursive: true }), which copies dot-folders, so public/.dev/folder.json lands at dist/games/retro/hivestorm/.dev/folder.json (checked by running the build). Wrangler's assets upload ignores only .assetsignore, _redirects and _headers unless an .assetsignore says otherwise, and Hivestorm has none, so the deploy would serve the file at icelander.net/games/retro/hivestorm/.dev/folder.json. It holds no secret, only a description of the folder. Rally's public/.dev/folder.json is in the same position.

options.title: Leave it
options.consequences: A small JSON file describing the page folder is public. Nothing else changes.

options.title: Skip .dev when copying public/ (build.mjs)
options.consequences: dist/ holds only the game; a change to build.mjs in each game that copies public/.

options.title: Add an .assetsignore to public/ listing .dev
options.consequences: The file is built but not uploaded; .assetsignore itself is never uploaded.

options.title: Write no .dev folder in public/
options.consequences: The page folder goes undocumented, against AGENTS.md's rule that every maintained folder documents itself.

entities.details: It blocks no work, but the merge that brings public/.dev/folder.json to main deploys it. The same question applies to every game whose build copies public/, and may be better answered once for all of them.
